--- text
foo| bar baz
--- keys
Type(X) End Cmd+Z
--- expect
foo| bar baz
--- note
Undo restores the caret to where it sat BEFORE the edit, not to wherever the
caret happens to be at the moment of undo. Typing X at column 3 makes
"fooX bar baz"; End then parks the caret at the line end (column 12). A single
undo removes the X and returns the caret to column 3, the spot it was typed
at, because each change records the selection that preceded it and undo
reinstates that selection. The intervening End is a selection-only move: it
carries no change of its own, so undo steps straight past it to the insertion.
Leaving the caret at column 12 would mean undo ignored the stored pre-edit
selection.
